versos.texto_bv: Porque, sim, porque enganaram o meu povo, dizendo: “Paz”, quando não há paz; constroem um muro e o rebocam com argamassa fraca.
versos.traducao_literal: Porque, e porque, enganaram povo-meu, para dizer: paz, e não paz; e ele edificando parede, e eis-eles rebocando-a insossa.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0028): O hebraico distingue dois sujeitos gramaticais na sequência "constroem um muro e o rebocam": וְהוּא בֹּנֶה חַיִץ (sujeito 3ª masc. SINGULAR, "ele/um edifica o muro") e וְהִנָּם טָחִים אֹתוֹ (sujeito 3ª masc. PLURAL, "eis que eles o rebocam"). O texto_bv usa um único sujeito plural indiferenciado ("constroem...rebocam") para as duas ações, apagando a distinção entre quem ergue o muro e quem o reboca com argamassa fraca. — evidência: termos_originais: וְהוּא֙ lemma c/1931, morfologia HC/Pp3ms (pronome 3ª masc. singular) + בֹּ֣נֶה lemma 1129, HVqrmsa (particípio singular); וְהִנָּ֛ם lemma c/2009, HC/Tm/Sp3mp (partícula com sufixo 3ª masc. plural) + טָחִ֥ים lemma 2902 a, HVqrmpa (particípio plural). A traducao_literal preserva a distinção ("e ele edificando parede, e eis-eles rebocando-a insossa"), e a KJV de controle também a preserva ("and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter") — três camadas de controle (morfologia pinada, camada literal, KJV) convergem em manter sujeitos distintos que o texto_bv funde em um só.

kjv.texto: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:

vizinhos.9: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
vizinhos.11: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.

web.texto: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there is no peace; and when one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash:

vizinhos.9: My hand shall be against the prophets who see false visions, and who divine lies: they shall not be in the council of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and you shall know that I am the Lord Yahweh.
vizinhos.11: tell those who plaster it with whitewash, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall tear it.
